subject: Re: Benchmark snapshot — quick 30m to walk through findings?
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbleinsights.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up on the benchmark snapshot you downloaded

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for downloading the benchmark snapshot last week. I put together a short summary attached that highlights a few places where teams like yours typically see the biggest gains from rolling Redwood Inference into a demo pipeline (latency wins, batching impact, and cost/margin examples).

Would you be open to a focused 30-minute walkthrough next week so Evelyn (our solutions lead) can show the live dashboard and answer any infra/security questions? A couple of times that work on our side:

- Wed 9/13, 4:30–5:00pm PT
- Thu 9/14, 10:00–10:30am PT

If neither of those work, happy to send an auto-scheduler link — we can accommodate different time zones.

I attached the PDF summary for quick context.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: nimble-benchmark-summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbleinsights.com>

Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbleinsights.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on the benchmark snapshot you downloaded

Hi Ben —

Thanks — we did download the snapshot. Appreciate the summary.

Quick note on scheduling: we have a product sync mid-afternoon on Wednesday, so later in the day would be better for us. Thu 10am PT might be tricky for our engineering lead (Alex), could we do Thu 11:30am PT or Wed 5:00pm PT? If neither works, Friday morning (9/15) around 10am PT would be my second choice.

Can you also confirm a short agenda? Ideally we'd cover:
- Live demo of the model routing / latency dashboard (5–10m)
- Typical throughput/cost improvements for a report-to-demo flow (10m)
- Security/hosting model question time (10m)

We'd like the session recorded and any collateral you can drop beforehand.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Analytics, Nimble Insights
sarah.li@nimbleinsights.com

- Wed 9/13, 5:00pm PT — Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/i/evt/abc123 (provisional)
- Thu 9/14, 11:30am PT — Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/i/evt/def456 (provisional)

1) Quick context & introductions (5m)
2) Live walkthrough: benchmark routing, KV/prefix caching example (10m)

If Wed 5pm PT works, I'll mark that as the confirmed slot; if not, please accept the Thu 11:30 invite.

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — Wed 9/13 at 5:00pm PT works for us and I've confirmed the calendar invite. You'll see the meeting come from my calendar shortly (I included a short agenda and a few links in the invite).

A couple quick notes so we tailor the demo: could you tell us which of these matters most for your team?
- minimizing 95th percentile latency for interactive demos
- lowering per-token cost with intelligent batching and KV caching
- multi-region routing for end-user proximity

If Alex has particular infra/security questions, feel free to drop them into the calendar event or reply here and I'll make sure Sergio (our infra specialist) has a slide. We'll record and share the recording + links to the dashboard and the summary PDF afterward.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
